reply: Last time, you explained why a green square is allowed when every triangular piece is green: the requirement applies only to triangles. That same idea helps with the earlier statement, “Every star-shaped piece in this tray is red.” It requires stars to be red, but other shapes can be red too. A tray containing a red star and a red square still fits the description. So knowing that a selected piece is red does not tell us that it is star-shaped. The useful habit is to notice which pieces the sentence puts a requirement on.
